sloka: दृष्टं मे नन्दनं भग्नमृषयो निहताः श्रुताः ।देवतानां समुद्योगस्त्वत्तो राजन्मम श्रुतः ।। ७.१३.१९ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭaṁ me nandanaṁ bhagnamṛṣayo nihatāḥ śrutāḥ ।devatānāṁ samudyogastvatto rājanmama śrutaḥ ।। 7.13.19 ॥

translations.english: I have seen the Nandana garden destroyed, I have heard that sages were killed, and I have heard from you, O King, about the gods' preparations.
